description:
The Government intends to post a solicitation for Decking Hardware & Lumber Material for Saylorville Lake Visitor Center.

The Government anticipates soliciting a firm-fixed-price, 100% small business set aside, contract (purchase order) according to the attached Statement of Work.

THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETETIVE QUOTES AND AN ISSUED SOLICITATION IS FORTHCOMING.  ALSO BE ADVISED THAT THIS EFFORT MAY BE DELAYED, CANCELLED OR REVISED AT ANY TIME DURING THE PRE-SOLICITATION, SOLICITATION, SELECTION, EVALUATION, NEGOTIATION AND/OR FINAL AWARD PROCESS.
